name: tr_dependencies_installed
rubric: The OpenTelemetry SDK, the OTLP HTTP trace exporter, and auto-instrumentation for this stack are added with the package manager's install command. **N/A** when the app already exported OpenTelemetry traces. Judge only the changes this session made. Answer pass for YES or N/A, fail for NO.

name: tr_exporter_endpoint
rubric: Spans go over OTLP HTTP to the `/i/v1/traces` path on the PostHog host, with the project token in an `Authorization: Bearer` header. Using `/i/v0/ai/otel`, or setting only a base OTLP endpoint that would send other signals to the traces path, is NO. Judge only the changes this session made. Answer pass for YES or N/A, fail for NO.

name: tr_protocol
rubric: The exporter uses HTTP/protobuf, set explicitly where the SDK or agent defaults to gRPC. Judge only the changes this session made. Answer pass for YES or N/A, fail for NO.

name: tr_service_name
rubric: A service name is set through `service.name` or `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME`. Judge only the changes this session made. Answer pass for YES or N/A, fail for NO.

name: tr_provider_starts_first
rubric: The tracer provider starts before the application loads its frameworks, so auto-instrumentation can patch them, in the place PostHog's documentation for this stack names. Judge only the changes this session made. Answer pass for YES or N/A, fail for NO.

name: tr_auto_instrumentation
rubric: Auto-instrumentation is enabled, so HTTP server requests and outbound calls produce spans without hand-written spans around them. Judge only the changes this session made. Answer pass for YES or N/A, fail for NO.

name: tr_span_naming
rubric: Manual spans use low-cardinality names with variable values in attributes. **N/A** when the change adds no manual spans. Judge only the changes this session made. Answer pass for YES or N/A, fail for NO.

name: tr_token_host_env
rubric: The project token and host or endpoint are read from environment variables, not hard-coded. Judge only the changes this session made. Answer pass for YES or N/A, fail for NO.

name: tr_existing_preserved
rubric: An existing tracer provider or exporter is reused. Replacing or removing another tracing backend without the user asking is NO. Judge only the changes this session made. Answer pass for YES or N/A, fail for NO.
